notes.title: Play the demo for my upcoming point&click adventure "The Jester and the Madman"
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, 



just wanted to let you know that the sequel to "The Curse of the Old Gods" now has a demo available to play. The full release of "The Jester and the Madman" will be on 21st of October.  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3893670/The_Jester_and_the_Madman/"][/dynamiclink]

"The Jester and the Madman, a sequel to Curse of the Old Gods, is a point-and-click adventure with a 90s-style digitized art aesthetic, steeped in Lovecraftian horror. Solve puzzles, uncover a vast conspiracy, and descend into a world of cults, paranoia, and creeping madness."



Hope you'll check it out. 

   

Cheers,   

Tim[/p]

notes.title: My New Adventure "Cantaloupe Chronicle" is Releasing July 10th
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

just wanted to let you know that my new point&click adventure "Cantaloupe Chronicle" is coming soon... aka June 10th to Steam.

So if you're up for a new adventure, why not check out its Steam Page (and maybe put it on your wishlist too)?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176050/Cantaloupe_Chronicle/

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Arkham Nightmares will be going "free" on February 1st
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

this was the first game I published on Steam many many years ago and I think it's about time to release it to the public for free.

From February 1st onward the game will be free to download for everyone.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.02 with Story Mode released!
notes.content:
A new update is available for the game.

Featuring a completely new game mode: the "Story Mode". This will make it easier to complete the chapters as you are not disturbed by nightmares and won't lose any items during the night.

Also fixed the issue that the character sometimes got stuck and wasn't able to move anymore.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
[b]New Update released![/b]

New feature - Added an options dialog to the game including:
-The option to show the Keyboard Layout again
-Show a help screen that explains the basic game mechanics
-Quit and Resume the game

-Bugfix: Fixed a bug where you could get stuck
